newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: World Bank team will not negotiate Yugo membership.
newsitem.headline: World Bank team will not negotiate Yugo membership.

text.p: A World Bank delegation due to visit Belgrade in November will not be authorised to negotiate Yugoslavia's status in the international financial organisation, the newspaper Nasa Borba reported on Wednesday.

"A visit is planned for November, but that World Bank delegation will not have authorisation to negotiate Yugoslavia's membership," John Eisenhammer of Lowe Bell Financial, Yugoslavia's public relations adviser, was quoted by Nasa Borba as saying.
Yugoslav finance minister Tomica Raicevic said over the weekend a World Bank delegation had confirmed its visit to Yugoslavia in mid November.
"We will discuss our debts, experiences of eastern European transition economies and their structural changes, and especially experiences and prospects of the Yugoslav economy," Raicevic said.
The World Bank team's visit to Belgrade will be "within the framework of its tour of the countries of former Yugoslavia," Eisenhammer told Nasa Borba. -- Amra Kevic, Belgrade newsroom +381 11 2224305
